title: 2013 Toyota Highlander Passenger-Side Collision Repair
summary: Front passenger-side collision repair on a 2013 Toyota Highlander: new fender, headlight and bumper, painted to match the factory maroon.
story: This 2013 Toyota Highlander came in with the front passenger side caved in. The impact crushed the fender back into the door, destroyed the headlight assembly, tore the inner wheel liner out and split the bumper cover.

Carlos stripped the front end down to see what the collision had done underneath, then replaced the fender, headlight, liner and bumper components, checking the panel gaps against the hood and door as it went back together so the lines sat right.

The new panels were prepped, primed and sprayed to match the factory maroon, with the clear blended into the neighbouring panels. Insurance covered the work, and the Highlander went home looking like the accident never happened.
